tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Search the catalogue of public data sources (weather, water, hazards, flights, ships, energy, filings, trade, ...). Each entry gives the API, coverage, cadence, auth needed and licence. Use it to find where a kind of data comes from before writing a fetcher.

tools.name: list_hubs
tools.description: Projects and catalogues that collect sources (God's Eye View, World Monitor, the MCP Registry, Source Cooperative, ...), with how each relates to this one.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Named places the fetchers read for, with their upstream ids (CO-OPS station, USGS gauge, eBird region) and tags.

tools.name: get_readings
tools.description: Fetch current readings from one source, each with value, unit, a one-line summary, place and provenance (source, URL, fetch time, licence). Sources this server will not republish (non-commercial, restricted or unreviewed licence) answer with an error naming the licence.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Static public datasets this server holds as GeoJSON (wildfire burn perimeters, public-land share by county, federal campgrounds, fire-weather stations), with source, licence, feature count and parts (one per state, or "all").

tools.name: get_dataset_part
tools.description: The URL of one part of a dataset as GeoJSON, plus its description. Fetch the URL for the features; parts can be several megabytes.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: Map layers this server can draw as GeoJSON, with unit, source, licence, whether it is available here, and how to read it.

tools.name: get_layer
tools.description: One map layer as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection: one point per place with the reading on the date (else the latest observed before it, never a guess), or one point per event for event layers.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_readings, get_dataset_part · Public sink: list_datasets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_readings, get_dataset_part · Public sink: list_datasets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
